_doc: Fast-gate stem list for the escalation classifier. If an utterance contains NONE of these stems (case-insensitive substring match), the LLM escalation classifier is SKIPPED for that turn (verdict: no escalation) — the multilingual decomposer remains the second net. If ANY stem matches, the LLM classifier runs as usual and makes the real decision. Stems, not words: 'rezerv' matches rezervasyon/rezervasyonumu/rezerve. Err on the side of adding too many — a false trigger only costs one LLM call. Edits are picked up automatically (no restart). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
